bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
repo='seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot'
run='44975918711'
oldsha='0aea204a78c85997b971c650ebc9411c8d8365395ac0e5ef3e70587adb514ec7'
newsha='ae1efae7152d3ae8c161e1a06bfb6f0bc6278e44483eeeaf6ad20432b44e5443'
oldimage='sha256:14c1cea5c3c6a2f5669d2f2b5c77a0980e5207b281af75bedea20a5991f8cfad'
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldimage"
test "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local -f '{{.Id}}')" = "$oldimage"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$oldsha"
test -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/actions/runs/$run --jq '.conclusion')" = success
stage="$(mktemp -d)"
chmod 700 "$stage"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$stage"' EXIT
gh run download "$run" -R "$repo" -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$stage" >/dev/null
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$newsha"
printf '%s\n' 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-startless-20261122' 'USER root' 'COPY --chown=node:node gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs' 'USER node' > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker tag "$oldimage" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-startless-20261122
docker build --pull=false -q -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-20261122 -f "$stage/Dockerfile" "$stage" >/dev/null
test "$(docker run --rm --entrypoint sha256sum gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-20261122 /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$newsha"
docker run --rm --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-20261122 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-20261122 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up --no-deps -d --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-startless-20261122 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up --no-deps -d --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 echo STARTLESS_DEPLOY=ROLLED_BACK
 exit 71
fi
sleep 3
if [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != true ] || [ "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$newsha" ]; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-startless-20261122 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up --no-deps -d --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
 echo STARTLESS_DEPLOY=ROLLED_BACK_POSTCHECK
 exit 72
fi
echo STARTLESS_DEPLOY=PASS
echo STARTLESS_PRODUCTION_BUNDLE_SHA256="$newsha"
echo STARTLESS_OLD_IMAGE_PRESERVED=PASS
echo POSTGRES_USERBOT_UNTOUCHED=PASS
